resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two of three dates say 1942: the register's Built field and the Forest Lookouts account, which cites a book on Los Padres lookouts. The register's own description says constructed in 1943. The story uses 1942 and reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Built year disagrees within the register (Built 1942 field vs 1943 description); the Forest Lookouts page gives 1942 with an unseen 1988 book as its source. The 1944 'closed' event uses the first year of the register's 'sometime in 1944 or 45' range, so treat the year as approximate. The 1954 date and fire name agree across both sources (spelled Devils Peak on the register, Devil's Peak on Forest Lookouts). Record status 'gone' and elevation 1,350 m match the register (4,428 ft). No source found describes what remains on site today or public access. The register's Ron Kemnow link was not read. The Caliente and Mount Carmel stories share the AWS background, so the volunteer sentence is kept short.
